copy_lock.copy:
This is the kind of love
I want us to grow into.

The date began with one missing key
and two suspects.

By the third wrong turn,
nobody was cute anymore.

“Don’t talk to me.”

He gave her the minute.
Not the distance.

It wasn’t really the wrong turn.

They had simply missed each other
for too many ordinary days.

The plan failed.
The date didn’t.

He still checked the lock twice.
She still rolled her eyes.

Then she went back
and checked it with him.

Translate the selected visual system into specific final-generation and integrated-text constraints.
Select one system only after scoring copy alignment, relationship proof, visual variety, identity, aspect safety, and sendability.

slide_visual_blueprint.copy:
This is the kind of love
I want us to grow into.
slide_visual_blueprint.scene: Rain-damp evening beside a tiny roadside chai stall. Exactly Aachu and Zuv stand under one umbrella beside their modest dark car, safely parked on the quieter service lane away from traffic, dressed for a proper date. Across the divided road, through moving cars, the intended restaurant on the next road is visibly close but inconvenient to reach. The chai stall glows immediately beside them. Aachu points toward the chai stall with her right hand while her left hand stays relaxed at her side. Zuv holds the umbrella in his right hand and lowers the phone map in his left; they exchange a small conspiratorial 'shall we?' look. This is the decision before the accidental date, not the seated payoff. No chai vendor or background people visible.

slide_visual_blueprint.scene: Nonlinear callback to before departure for the date, viewed entirely from OUTSIDE the apartment in a dry corridor after the front door is fully closed. Use a medium-wide, nearly straight-on view with Aachu and Zuv on the same depth plane and almost the same apparent height; Zuv is only slightly taller. The closed door occupies the center, and its one exterior lever handle is clearly mounted on the RIGHT edge of the door beside Zuv. Stage Aachu on the left half of the door and Zuv immediately beside the handle on the right, with one forearm of clear empty space between their torsos: no hug, no waist hold, no leaning, no overlap, and no couple touch. Zuv's hips and shoes still aim left toward the elevator while his upper body twists back to the door. His LEFT forearm is completely uncovered and visibly travels from shoulder to elbow to wrist to a five-finger grip wrapped around the exterior handle; the lever angles down slightly under his pulling/testing tension. His RIGHT arm stays naturally behind his own back with its hand hidden: never crossed over his torso and never in a pocket. Deeper behind Aachu on frame left, the elevator doors are halfway through closing and the call button glows. Aachu is caught mid-pivot back from that elevator: her left foot remains pointed toward it, her right foot steps back toward the apartment, her heel is lifted, and three tiny fading graphite motion ticks curve from the elevator threshold to that heel. These are physical movement marks, not an arrow, label, ghost figure, or duplicate body. Standing separately from Zuv, Aachu extends her RIGHT arm across clear open air and presses her fully visible palm flat on the closed center-left door panel, well away from his handle hand. Her fingers, palm, wrist, forearm, and sleeve remain continuously readable from shoulder to door. Her soft tote hangs from her left shoulder and the tightly rolled bone-dry umbrella rests under her left arm, naturally hiding that hand without covering the focal right arm. Zuv looks down at his own handle grip; Aachu looks at her own palm-to-door contact. Their small smiles stay secondary to the action; they do not look at each other or the viewer. Identity and wardrobe lock: Aachu has her real soft oval face, predominantly straight long dark hair, white shirt, blue jeans, and red flats; Zuv has his real broader face, swept wavy quiff rather than tight ringlets, trimmed full beard, light blue shirt, loose grey trousers, and red-black shoes. Both participate in the check: two separated bodies, two distinct action arms, two separate door contacts, the flexed handle, outward lower bodies, Aachu's pivot trail, closed door, closing elevator, and dry corridor must make the silent read unmistakable—while leaving for the date, he tests the handle and she turns back to test the same closed door with him. Exactly two people. No visible key or key fob. Never show an interior entryway, open door, post-date return, rain marks, folded or pocketed Zuv arms, an untouched handle, only one partner checking, mutual flirtation gaze, Aachu touching Zuv, overlapping torsos, readable arrows or labels, ghosted bodies, scooter, motorbike, or helmets.
